Direct Wowhead is still Cloudflare-403 from this runner, but ALL 6 pages landed through r.jina.ai this run — including the M+ TANK page that failed the last several runs. The fix was the `x-no-cache: true` header: without it jina returned the cached amazon-adsystem tracker stub again, with it the real page came through on the first try (`x-target-selector` still 422s; `x-return-format: html` also works as a backup). 80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, 0 tier moves vs committed. Two upstream formatting quirks handled: healer pages use "S-Tier" with a hyphen, and M+ DPS entry 16 is missing its opening paren ("Subtlety Rogue B Tier)"). Era-verified Midnight Season 1 / Patch 12.0.7 on every page. All 6 snapshots now 07-26, so the requirement's oldest-page probe advances 07-22 -> 07-26 for the first time since the tank page broke.

Archon's own lastUpdated is still 2026-07-24T12:00Z — unchanged from last run, i.e. upstream has not re-run its aggregation since, so identical tiers here are a genuine re-pull of unchanged data rather than a skipped fetch. DISTILLED 12 specialist takes from 4 of them: LBNinja7 MFpxVDQGU5I (7 takes — his Season-2 healer review covers all seven healers, every one inside his declared scope: Preservation needs no fixing / Flame Shaper cranking damage, Mistweaver very good but one-hero-tree, Holy Pal loved but 'just a whack-a-mole healer', Resto Druid set RNG improved not solved, Disc lacking ramp punch, Holy Priest no reason over Disc in keys, Resto Shaman set punishes unclumped parties); AutomaticJak n1NSfmvMrhU (2 — Holy Pal 'very good right now' post-tier-set change, Mistweaver dropped to 'decent in keys, falling behind in raid' after Morning Breeze -60%); Obli UJxhJRYxe9s (2 — San'layn Unholy inches ahead of Frost with great ST/execute but weak 2-3 target cleave and a real difficulty jump; Frost keeps the better cleave/add-burst profile); Tettles G4booQ9CGSE (1 — Moonkin's M+ meta slot is earned by its own damage, tagged 12.0.7-live lens so it does not supersede his 07-15 S2-raid take). Superseded 14 older same-(creator, spec, lens) takes. izen wa60mXTVPxY -> 3 metaNotes (M+ lens): Blood DK the headline tank riser (DR-focused buffs, popularity near Prot Pal, San'layn now the majority pick), Marksmanship rising to #2 popularity but explicitly NOT from the failed talent rework, Mistweaver still the most promising healer even after Morning Breeze -60%; superseded 2 older izen M+ notes. Prot Paladin was deliberately NOT written as a new metaNote — the video only restates his existing 07-09 note as context for Blood's rise. TWO transcript-verified SKIPS, no takes: Shadarek ZAjeE9_d79E is a Season-2 dungeon creature-health/systems commentary with no read on any spec, and Kalamazi 4GG1seubsZ8 (published 07-24) covers the same Affliction bug fixes / Demo nerf / 'Destro in a weird spot' ground as his NEWER -G4jfNvelp0 video already distilled on 07-25, so re-adding it would have back-dated duplicate takes.
